description: A dark cup sits on the red-covered surface, with a blue-and-silver bottle standing to its right in front of a tan backdrop. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the bottle as a right-hand object and lifts it up and left while the left hand moves in to grip the cup as a left-hand object, tipping the cup slightly; the right hand then rotates the bottle downward over the cup’s opening to pour, before lifting the bottle back upright and returning it toward its original spot as the left hand steadies and lowers the cup.
